versions.changelog:
Initial release of the HR Recruitment JD Generator skill.

- Enables generating structured recruitment JDs and initializing workspace files based on six key user inputs.
- Supports optional integration with configurable models or defaults to local rule-based generation if models are not set—no process blocking for missing models.
- Guides model configuration securely using OPIE Engine environment variables; prohibits handling API Keys in chat, logs, files, or requests.
- Interfaces with existing CLI to process and generate output, showing clear success, warning, and fallback messages to users.
- Ensures all generated results require human HR review and comply with anti-discrimination and legal standards.
- Handles common errors such as duplicate job IDs and model configuration issues informatively.
